observation_unit_default: Survey response, or employee journey event (e.g. onboarding case) - choose one per analysis

core_fields.description: Reporting group (site, function, tenure band) - suppressed below minimum group size

metric_library.name: eNPS
metric_library.definition: % promoters (9-10) minus % detractors (0-6); always report all three shares
metric_library.notes: Positive eNPS does not mean detractors are absent

metric_library.name: Top-2-box share
metric_library.definition: Responses in the top two scale points / responses
metric_library.notes: Ordinal: report the distribution; 7-point scales have a midpoint

metric_library.name: Day-1 readiness
metric_library.definition: New joiners with equipment, access and buddy ready on day 1 / new joiners

metric_library.name: Time to productivity
metric_library.definition: Days from start date to productive sign-off

sensitivity_notes: Anonymous, aggregate reporting only, with groups suppressed below the minimum size set by organisation policy. Never combine with individual psychometric or performance data for decisions. Send works-council, legal and privacy questions for qualified review.
